The CI workflow routes kind other than docs to its full checks and resource-guard jobs.

It does not exercise malformed run JSON after a valid listing, or assert the CLI's scope=full output when either proof response is malformed. Existing success and cancelled cases provide contrasting outputs for the source function, but the malformed case stops before the workflow-facing decision.
